findings.desc: B-5952 CHK-001 edge/adversarial verification receipts do not execute the promised finite-bound mutations. Replace the tautological probes with isolated executable mutations that first fail, restore the committed control, then pass, and record verifier-admissible receipts.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.ts:664-914 [high] CHK-001:adversarial:binding-scope-mutants does not prove the protected-document mutation returns nonzero as required. Parse --json and require status=fail/nonzero plus the exact protected path/rule, then restore bytes and require an explicit status=pass control before re-recording the receipt and resolutions.
